UP Gautam Buddh Nagar ECCE Educator Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : UP Rojgar Sangam (Sewayojan) Portal has released the notification for the post of ECCE Educator in the Department of Basic Education Uttar Pradesh. This recruitment has been issued for 03 posts. The online application process for UP Gautam Buddh Nagar ECCE Educator Recruitment 2026 has started on 19 June 2026, and candidates can apply till 27 June 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UP Gautam Buddh Nagar ECCE Educator Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 19 June 2026
  • Last Date : 27 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : 0/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • No Application Fees For Any Candidates

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
